description: This file defines a custom LoggingTensor class and related utilities for logging and debugging tensor operations within PyTorch, including context managers and handlers for capturing logs and tracebacks.

classes.name: LoggingTensor
classes.description: A custom tensor class that wraps a torch.Tensor and logs operations for debugging.

classes.name: LoggingTensorMode
classes.description: A TorchDispatchMode that logs tensor operations.

classes.name: LoggingTensorReentrant
classes.description: A subclass of LoggingTensor that enables reentrant dispatch context.

classes.name: LoggingTensorHandler
classes.description: A logging handler that formats and stores tensor operation logs.

classes.name: GatherTraceback
classes.description: A logging filter that gathers traceback information for logs.

methods.name: log_input
methods.description: Logs an input variable with a given name.

methods.name: capture_logs
methods.description: Context manager that captures logs and tracebacks during execution.

methods.name: capture_logs_with_logging_tensor_mode
methods.description: Context manager that captures logs with LoggingTensorMode enabled.
